part.Name: Description
part.Short: A phial of thickened blaze rides in the socket behind the arrowhead, sloshing and warm.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Heats what it strikes. Repeated hits will set a target alight.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Frost creeps down the wooden shank from a bulb of pressurized cryo gas. The bulb is scored to split cleanly.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Chills what it strikes. Repeated hits will freeze a target solid.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The arrowhead is grooved and damp with dream dew. Struck hard enough, it beads off into a sweet fog.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Bursts into a cloud of sleep gas where it lands.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A waxed bulb of hulk honey rides behind the arrowhead, so thick it barely moves when the shaft does. It bursts on impact and sets fast.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Mires what it strikes. A target must pull free before it can move or attack.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A thin wax shell packed with white powder caps the wooden shank. It goes off with a clap and a scouring light.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Bursts with a blinding flash where it lands, dazing those caught in it.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A hollowed stinger caps the wooden shank, its sac still swollen behind the barb. It splits on impact and breathes out a green haze.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Bursts into a cloud of poison gas where it lands.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A crimped paper shell stencilled with a flame. The shot inside is jacketed in a compound that lights as it leaves the barrel.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Heats what it strikes. Repeated hits will set a target alight.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Frost beads along the crimp. The shot is a cluster of scored gas bulbs, each one built to split rather than deform.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Chills what it strikes. Repeated hits will freeze a target solid, whatever its shape.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: No shot in this one. A bundle of finned steel darts stands packed nose-forward behind the wad, sized to slip between plates rather than dent them.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Trades stopping power for penetration. Tells against armor and wastes itself on anything without any.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Dyed orange along its whole length so that no one loads it by mistake. It throws weighted batons trailing filament, and they wrap what they land on.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Knocks targets off their feet, and brings fliers down for a while. Insects, oozes and anything else without usable legs stay standing.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The jacket is blistered and weeping at the crimp. Sealed inside is a measure of decanted sludge, which eats iron the way air and rain do and does not wait a year about it.

part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Has a 5% chance on hit to rust a piece of what the target is carrying. Rusted gear is slow and nearly worthless until repaired, and a rusted artifact stops working entirely. Wasted on anything carrying nothing, or nothing made of metal.
